sourceBuildPackage.description: A package built from source (git clone + build system invocation).

binaryName.description: Filename of the built binary (e.g. ncdu.exe).

binarySubDir.description: Subdirectory within the build output where the binary resides (e.g. zig-out/bin).

buildSystem.description: Build system / toolchain used to compile the package.

checkVersionArgs.description: CLI arguments passed to the binary to print its version string.

checkVersionPattern.description: Regex pattern to extract the version from the binary's --version output.

dependencies.description: Build-time dependencies (Scoop package names or system tools).

installDir.description: Subdirectory name under the source-builds root for this package's binary (e.g. ncdu).

description: Registry of Windows packages built from source (git clone + build system). Mirrors the declarative approach of nixpkgs mkDerivation for the Windows host.
title: nucleus Windows source-builds registry
